nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implements LspTool, the agent Tool that talks to a Language Server Protocol server to run diagnostics and code-intelligence actions (definitions, references, hover, symbols) against workspace files.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs an LspTool bound to an LSP manager, app handle, and workspace root.

nodes.name: ensure_server_ready
nodes.summary: Starts or waits for the language server for a file's language before use.

nodes.name: sync_document
nodes.summary: Opens or updates a document on the LSP server, tracking sync versions.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Returns the tool's human-readable description text shown to the agent.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Declares the JSON schema of parameters this tool accepts.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Entry point that dispatches an LSP tool invocation to diagnostics or code-intelligence handling.

nodes.name: run_diagnostics
nodes.summary: Ensures the server is ready, syncs documents, and collects/formats LSP diagnostics for the given files.

nodes.name: run_code_intelligence_action
nodes.summary: Dispatches a code-intelligence action (definition, references, hover, symbols) to the LSP server and formats the result.

nodes.name: extract_paths_param
nodes.summary: Extracts and validates the file-paths parameter from tool call params.

nodes.name: expand_diagnostic_paths
nodes.summary: Expands directory paths into individual supported source files for diagnostics.

nodes.name: extract_position
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a 1-indexed line/character position from params, converting to 0-indexed LSP coordinates.

nodes.name: LspTool
nodes.summary: Tool implementation that queries an LSP server for diagnostics and code intelligence, tracking per-document sync versions.

nodes.name: post_edit.rs
nodes.summary: Fetches LSP diagnostics for a file immediately after an edit and filters them down to actionable ones.

nodes.name: get_post_edit_diagnostics
nodes.summary: Ensures the LSP server is ready, syncs the edited document, and requests fresh diagnostics for it.

nodes.name: is_actionable_diagnostic
nodes.summary: Determines whether a diagnostic is severe enough to be worth surfacing to the agent.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for the query_lsp module covering language detection, URI conversion, diagnostics/hover/location formatting, and diagnostic path expansion.

nodes.name: diag
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a mock LSP Diagnostic value for use in assertions.

nodes.name: loc
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a mock LSP Location value for use in assertions.

nodes.name: version.rs
nodes.summary: Tracks per-document LSP synchronization version numbers keyed by language and URI so edits are sent with correct versioning.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates an empty DocumentVersionTracker.

nodes.name: next
nodes.summary: Returns the next version number for a document, incrementing the stored counter.

nodes.name: reset
nodes.summary: Clears all tracked document versions for a language.

nodes.name: DocumentVersionTracker
nodes.summary: Keyed map of LSP document sync versions used to send correctly-versioned didChange notifications.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a default RenderInlineCanvasTool instance.

nodes.summary: Returns the tool's usage description and guidance text.

nodes.name: RenderInlineCanvasTool
nodes.summary: Tool that renders inline canvas content in the agent chat UI.

nodes.name: terminal_log.rs
nodes.summary: Writes structured YAML-header-plus-stream logs for terminal/subprocess executions, including log rotation of old run logs.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Builds a LogHeader with pid, cwd, command, and start timestamp.

nodes.name: to_yaml
nodes.summary: Serializes the LogHeader into a YAML front-matter block.

nodes.name: escape_yaml_string
nodes.summary: Escapes a string for safe embedding in YAML scalar values.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates a new TerminalLogWriter, writing the initial log file and header.

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends a line of output to the terminal log stream.

nodes.name: flush
nodes.summary: Flushes buffered log writes to disk.

nodes.name: finalize
nodes.summary: Finalizes the log by rewriting the header with completion status and exit code.

nodes.name: cleanup_old_logs
nodes.summary: Deletes old terminal log files beyond a retention count.

nodes.name: workspace_slug
nodes.summary: Derives a filesystem-safe slug identifying a workspace for log directory naming.

nodes.name: resolve_logs_root
nodes.summary: Resolves the root directory under which terminal logs for a workspace are stored.

nodes.name: LogProcessStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of terminal process states: Running, Backgrounded, Exited, Killed.

nodes.name: LogHeader
nodes.summary: YAML-serializable header describing a logged process (pid, cwd, command, status, timing).

nodes.name: TerminalLogWriter
nodes.summary: Writer that streams subprocess output to a log file with a YAML header and rotation support.
